name: megascenes-social-post
description: Design a social media post with your message on it, as a square feed post, a tall story or a pin, for announcements, quotes, sales and tips.

interface.shortDescription: Posts with your message on it
interface.longDescription:
Give the message, an optional smaller line such as a date or a website, what it is about and the style. You get a post with your words on it, in the shape you need: a square post for Instagram, a 9:16 story or a 3:4 Pinterest pin.

ChatGPT tells you what the design needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The post opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For small businesses, creators, events and announcements.

Limitations: your text is passed to the model as written and the lettering is drawn by the model, so check it in the result. It does not publish the post to your accounts. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Design a post with your message
Pick the shape for a feed post, story or pin
Return the post in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make an Instagram post that says Grand opening this Saturday
Design a story announcing our summer sale, 30% off
Create a quote post with Small steps every day

positive.prompt: Which models can design a social media post here?
positive.expected_behavior: The social post models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Make an Instagram post for my coffee shop that says Grand opening this Saturday. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one post with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which model is best for the text on a post?
positive.expected_behavior: The models with their settings, to choose one for lettering. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Make an Instagram post for my coffee shop that says Grand opening this Saturday. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my social media post on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my social media post to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
